title: Set Up: From Bean to Bean

scenes.tts: You need bush bean seeds labelled untreated, potting mix, and two or three pots with drainage holes.
scenes.narration: You need bush bean seeds labelled untreated, potting mix, and two or three pots with drainage holes.

scenes.tts: Fill each pot with potting mix to about two centimetres below the rim. Push two or three seeds about three centimetres deep. Water until it drips out the bottom. Set the pot in the sunniest window.
scenes.narration: Fill each pot with potting mix to about two centimetres below the rim. Push two or three seeds about three centimetres deep. Water until it drips out the bottom. Set the pot in the sunniest window.

scenes.tts: Visit once a week. In warm weather, a hooked stem usually pushes up in five to fourteen days. Flowers usually open about four to seven weeks after planting.
scenes.narration: Visit once a week. In warm weather, a hooked stem usually pushes up in five to fourteen days. Flowers usually open about four to seven weeks after planting.

scenes.tts: Do not eat raw bean pods or seeds. Keep loose seeds away from children under four.

items.text: No raw beans; seeds away from under-4s
